name: NeRF Image Refinement through End-to-End Sampling Point Optimization
aliases: Neural Radiance Field Image Refinement through End-to-End Sampling Point Optimization
definition: A method that optimizes sampling points along a ray tailored to the characteristics of the target scene to reduce artifacts and produce more detailed images in NeRF, using an MLP-Mixer-based architecture for dynamic configuration.
summary: This method optimizes sampling point positions along camera rays using an MLP-Mixer to dynamically concentrate points near surfaces, reducing artifacts and improving NeRF image detail.
